backend/main.mo: Minimal Motoko actor with no functionality.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing prewritten summaries for multiple frontend source files.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind base styles defining theme color tokens, dark mode variants, and default body styling.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point mounting React root and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app layout combining shell, vinyl player, HDD visualizer, and category overlay with hover and selection state.
frontend/src/components/CategoryModal.ts: Empty component file with no implementation.
Scrollable glass-morphism overlay showing category details with escape handling, backdrop, and dynamic sections.
frontend/src/components/HDDHub.tsx: Hard disk visualization with layered images, hover-based arm rotation, disk spin animation, and asset fallback chains.
frontend/src/components/PortfolioShell.t: Wrapper applying dimmed background image with fallback loading and containing all app content.
frontend/src/components/VinylPlayer.tsx: Interactive vinyl player with play/pause audio control, rotating record, and image fallback handling.
frontend/src/data/categories.ts: Defines the Category interface and a list of category objects with ids, names, and descriptions.
frontend/src/data/categoryOverlayContent: Provides placeholder overlay content for each category, including text sections and photo metadata.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor using React Query, updating it when the user identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements Internet Identity authentication context, handling login, identity storage, and state management.
frontend/src/index.css: Sets up Tailwind CSS layers and custom CSS variables plus utility classes and animations.
frontend/src/lib/assetFallbacks.ts: Defines fallback chains for asset loading and provides an SVG placeholder generator.
frontend/src/lib/assetUrls.ts: Resolves asset URLs using Vite's BASE_URL and exports canonical asset paths.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Exports a utility function to merge class names using clsx and tailwind-merge.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentity providers before rendering App.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind config enabling dark mode, custom color variables, extended utilities, animations, and typography/container/animate plugins.
frontend/vite.config.ts: Vite config for React with env loading, dev proxy to /api, path aliasing, and esbuild global polyfill.
project_state.json: Project state record describing a React/TS portfolio with HDD hub interactions, vinyl audio control, layout details, and known geometry/rendering issues.
